changes.proposed: Every 12 weeks from first HER2 dose; first check around cycle 5 if on time. Earlier for symptoms or concern.
Check the last result and next due date before the postoperative plan; do not reset the cardiac clock.
Follow the separately selected postoperative regimen and any abnormal results; do not carry over the neoadjuvant Day 8 schedule.

reason: Cycle-5 echo currently lives under Surgery/pathology; postoperative blood cell duplicates neoadjuvant requirements.

changes.proposed: Response imaging at the MDT-selected time; not automatically tied to the week-12 echo.

Use plain language: After surgery, the team chooses the next HER2 medicine from the pathology results. Its own monitoring and supportive plan applies. Do not instruct patients about metastatic regimen code 00785.

reason: The fixed week-12 column may imply a universal imaging date that NCCP does not specify. Internal coding guidance is inappropriate patient-facing prose.

changes.proposed: The selected postoperative regimen determines emetic risk, premedication and tests. Phesgo or trastuzumab alone generally needs no routine antiemetic prophylaxis; this statement must not be applied automatically to an antibody-drug conjugate. Open the selected regimen before issuing a supportive prescription.

changes.reason: Postoperative selection is on p1; TRAIN-2 p8 is a count table, not the postoperative or minimal-emetic source.

reason: Empty orders are appropriate, but the unknown postoperative medicine should not inherit a minimal-risk plan simply because it is HER2-directed.
